caption: The drawing depicts a single large metal bell mounted on a yoke. The bell has a broad, flared shape at its base and tapers slightly towards the top, with subtle color variations including shades of green, bronze, blue, and brown, indicating its metallic surface and patina. The yoke holding the bell is an arching, thick bracket with a reddish-brown, rust-like coloration, attached at both ends to bolts or pivot points on either side of the bell. The yoke features raised lettering; on the left arm, there is "NO 30" and on the right arm, there is "YOKE." The bell and yoke are centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or context visible in the image. The drawing uses shading and highlights to give the bell a three-dimensional, realistic appearance.
title: Church Bell
